title: SimpleBox4nano: environmental fate modelling of nanomaterials via the Enalos Cloud Platform
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2026, Advance Article

Dimitris G. Mintis, Sotiris Kallishis, Panagiotis D. Kolokathis, Andreas Tsoumanis, Georgia Melagraki, Joris T. K. Quik, J. A. J. Meesters, Iseult Lynch, Dario Greco, Antreas Afantitis
This work presents a web application, freely accessible through the Enalos Cloud Platform (https://www.enaloscloud.novamechanics.com/insight/simplebox4nano/), integrating the SimpleBox4nano model and simplifying its Excel-based implementation.
